items.headline: Tattoo shops in the Village of East Davenport one step closer to staying
items.summary: Two tattoo shops will be forced to move unless City Council approves a zoning law change allowing them to stay in the Village.

items.headline: Iowa Central Community College offering first-in-nation Workforce Pell for EMT training course
items.summary: Students can receive up to $7,395 through Workforce Pell for the college's 14-week EMT program.

items.headline: All 20 Eldridge volunteer firefighters say they're quitting Oct. 1
items.summary: It comes amid ongoing disputes over the best path forward after the city council voted to make the volunteer fire company a city department.

items.headline: Quad City brothers return from BMX world championships in Australia
items.summary: Knox and Deacon Reaves are no strangers to Team USA BMX competitions, but this was the first time they were able to represent their country together.

items.headline: Police: Davenport man charged after armed robbery at Hilltop Grocery
items.summary: A Davenport man is accused of robbing Hilltop Grocery at gunpoint Monday morning before police found and arrested him later that day.

items.headline: Pritzker signs bills allowing Illinois to review insurance rate hikes
items.summary: The new laws give the Insurance Department rate review authority for homeowners, auto policies.

items.headline: Crews respond to apartment fire in Davenport
items.summary: The Davenport Fire Department responded to an apartment fire in the 1500 block of Harrison Street Monday.

items.headline: Iowa DNR investigating wastewater discharge that reached Mississippi River in Keokuk
items.summary: Repairs are underway. Those using the river recreationally downstream should use extra caution and avoid the area, the Iowa DNR recommended.
